name: Chat
description: Interactive chat trigger that executes workflow for each message and returns responses in real-time.

properties.name: autoPersist
properties.description: Persist user messages automatically to SQLite when chatId/sessionId are present. Leave off when using built-in Chat API to avoid duplicates.

properties.name: persistMode
properties.description: Select message mode when auto-persisting (auto derives from metadata.mode).

properties.name: chatId
properties.description: The unique ID for this chat. Is generated automatically.

properties.name: chatName
properties.description: Display name for the chat assistant.

properties.name: welcomeMessage
properties.default: Hello! How can I help you today?
properties.description: Initial message shown when chat opens.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder text for the message input.

properties.name: theme
properties.description: Visual theme for the chat interface.

properties.name: primaryColor
properties.description: Main color for the chat interface.

properties.name: notice
properties.default: This chat has two modes: Test mode for development (FAB button in editor) and Production mode with a shareable link.

properties.name: testUrl
properties.description: Test your chat directly in the workflow editor using the floating chat button.

behavior.value: Click the chat icon in the bottom-right corner of the editor to test your chat

properties.name: prodUrl
properties.description: Shareable link for production use. Share this with your users.

properties.name: enableHistory
properties.description: Store and display conversation history for each session.

properties.name: maxHistoryLength
properties.description: Maximum number of messages to keep in history per session.

properties.name: enableMessageLimit
properties.description: Enable a maximum number of messages for the chat session.

properties.name: maxMessages
properties.description: Maximum number of messages allowed in the chat session.

properties.name: messageLimitExceededAction
properties.description: Action to take when the message limit is reached.

properties.name: predefinedResponseMessage
properties.default: You have reached the message limit for this chat. Please restart the conversation or open a new chat.
properties.description: Message to send when the limit is exceeded and 'Respond with Predefined Message' is selected.
